epistemic_channel_definitions.abstained: Tick routed to NO_OP abstention (mode 3: noop_abstain) by route_proposals_with_commit_gate on the diagnostic stream.
epistemic_channel_definitions.fallback_mitigated: Tick routed to trusted-proprioception fallback (mode 1: commit_trusted_proprio) or cautious probe (mode 2: probe_cautious) by route_proposals_with_commit_gate.
epistemic_channel_definitions.ground_truth_eval: Simulator ground-truth object coordinate trajectory plotted strictly for evaluation comparison (never observed by model proprioception).
epistemic_channel_definitions.observed: Model-visible sensory frame, spectrogram, or end-effector proprioception recorded from environment.
epistemic_channel_definitions.predicted: Action-conditioned future latent rollout, decoded spatial pose/hazard map, or recalled symbolic binding.
epistemic_channel_definitions.reconstructed: Stop-gradient diagnostic patch/audio linear readout from current latent state Z_task.
